periods.time: vol-11 ch-001 afternoon before the championship final
periods.location: League training facility battle ring near Bay Dome
periods.summary: Ikki spars with Alice, then accepts help from former rivals and allies including Toka, Moroboshi, Byakuya, Momiji, Kaga, Kikyo and Botan. He defeats successive opponents through Perfect Vision, Edelweiss-derived movement, improvised counters, and unshakable battlefield awareness. Moroboshi tells him not to stand on the final stage with half-hearted confidence; Ouma then appears and forces Ikki to test himself against the pressure of a superior power.
periods.cause: Ikki fears Stella's awakened dragon power and asks strong opponents to keep his body and mind at maximum readiness.
periods.process: Alice first tests Ikki's alertness with shadow beasts and shadow movement. The Hagure sisters, Byakuya, Momiji and Kaga fall in rapid succession; Kaga's ambush confirms Ikki's constant readiness. Toka's Denkou and Raikiri pressure Ikki until he blocks her draw with battlefield debris. Moroboshi pushes Ikki through spear-range pressure. Ouma arrives to see whether Ikki's weak sword can face a dragon.
periods.outcome: Ikki's fear cools into resolve. His body stops producing cold sweat, and he enters the final already heated to peak combat condition.
periods.significance: Shows Ikki converting fear into readiness and receiving the will of many defeated rivals before the final.
